about: Labelled Ask Coach messages for a fictional graduate (CFS-146). expect: answer (a grounded career answer) or reply (a short reply without advice). personal marks questions about the user, where the answer should cite at least one of their facts.
goal: A graduate data analyst role in Sydney, building reports and dashboards with SQL and Python.
